name: Antivenom
marques: While under the effect of an animal venom, take an antivenom potion to re-roll the resist and get a result one tier higher.
text: While under the effect of an animal venom, take an antivenom potion to re-roll the resist and get a result one tier higher. Can be tried several times with several potions.

name: Antivenom Plus
notes: Antivenom must also be on the medicine
text: Re-roll the venom resist with two extra tiers, and gain the marque bonus to resist that poison until the next breather.

name: Sedative
marques: Once per downtime lowers a captive animal's taming tier by 1.
text: Once per downtime lowers a captive animal's taming tier by 1. The potion maker has one potion fewer after that downtime when it is used.

name: Venomized
marques: Instead of this augment's effect, use the effect of any venom you have extracted, bought or created.
text: Instead of this augment's effect, use the effect of any venom you have extracted, bought or created.

name: Mobile Animal
marques: The animal gains an additional movement trait.
text: The animal gains an additional movement trait. Not the Mobile special trait; cannot be taken if the animal already has all movement traits.

name: Prehensile
marques: Tendrils, thumbs or other grasping: the animal gains the Prehensile Limbs special trait, but no SP from it.
text: Tendrils, thumbs or other grasping: the animal gains the Prehensile Limbs special trait, but no SP from it.

name: Specialized Animal
qualifiers: needs a known animal special trait
marques: The animal gets one more Special Trait that you know, without SP from it.
text: The animal gets one more Special Trait that you know, without SP from it.

name: Adaptive Versatility
text: Gives no ability. Instead +2 to two of its combat stats and +6 HP. Anything that modifies HP gained from SP also affects this HP (Hardy → +10, Extra Hardy → +14).

name: Blooded
text: When it becomes aware of a bleeding opponent on the battlefield: +1 Strike, plus +2 Strike more when attacking that opponent. Can stack for several bleeding opponents.

name: Boneless
text: Contorts into spaces much smaller than its body. Gains the effects of Cover Expert (espionage-cover-expert) and can squeeze to one size tier smaller; a small animal can squeeze through openings a few inches wide.

name: Camouflage
text: Active camouflage: can hide in plain sight. Bonus to its Hide roll equal to 2 × SP.

name: Crushing Grab
text: Can use the effect of the Crushing Grip specialty (brawl-crushing-grip) with its natural weapons.

name: Constricting
text: When it holds an opponent, the opponent must make a Breath Holding check as if they had no last breath. While held they suffocate and pass out when their time runs out unless they break the grab.

name: Defensive Advantage
text: +2 soak class on its natural armor.

name: Defensive Curl
text: Curls into a ball: +6 soak class and +10 Defense. No actions except leaving the stance.

name: Deflection
text: Deflects attacks with its body as if it had a shield.

name: Disinfectant
text: Secretes enzymes or eats dead flesh: allies' wounds heal at twice the normal rate (does not stack with several animals). Cancels all necrotizing effects on the player.

name: Disorienting Attack
text: Its attack disorients the opponent for 1 turn per strike tier.

name: Echolocating
text: Can hear anything it could ordinarily see, except colors and textures.

name: Fearsome
text: Instead of Brute Intimidate it has Brute Terrify: the opponent takes a fear result by the animal's Brute roll, tiered down by their resist.

name: Feign Death
text: Gains all abilities of Feign Fatal Wounds (espionage-feign-fatal-wounds), but enters the stance reflexively and cannot act in it except to leave. Can leave reflexively when attacked and gets a free attack on the attacker (AP-costing attack modifiers still cost AP). Uses Cunning for the stance's effectiveness.

name: Flesh Tearing
text: When it inflicts a called-shot effect that ends after a time or after actions, that effect does not end until the opponent's bleeding has also been patched.

name: Forcible Will
text: Gains the benefits of Force of Self (grace-force-of-self), using Spirit instead of the Grace skill.

name: Gallop
text: If it spends at least 3 AP moving in a turn, it moves at twice its normal speed.

name: Hardy
text: Gains 10 HP per SP instead of 6.

name: Extra Hardy
text: Gains 14 HP per SP instead of 10.

name: Herd Instincts
text: +1 Evade for each other allied animal within 25 ft that has the Herd Instincts trait or story.

name: Howl
text: Guttural howl: +1 per SP marque on all rolls of the next attack, or the next evade and defense attempt, of an ally within 25 ft.

name: Hypnotic
text: Hypnotic gaze: benefits from Connection (grace-connection), using Spirit instead of Grace for the bonus.

name: Ink
text: Called shot to the eyes with ink using only its Accuracy, for 2 AP. No damage; if not resisted the target is blinded and acts as if fighting in darkness until they spend 2 AP to clean it out. Uses per breather = SP marque; anything that changes its venom dose count changes this too.

name: Intimidating
text: Its Brute intimidations are one tier more effective. Above T4: +1 to the AP that cannot be used to attack it. With Fearsome: fear effect +1 tier (max T4).

name: Loud
text: Loud aggressive noises: opponents must roll concentration (Spirit) against the animal's Cunning to notice silent movement or hear allies' vocal cues.

name: Mobile
text: Gains an additional movement trait. Can be taken several times; no movement trait more than once.

name: Offensive Advantage
text: Its natural attacks gain +2 damage class.

name: Pack Instincts
text: +1 Strike for each other allied animal within 25 ft that has the Pack Instincts trait or story.

name: Phase Step
text: Benefits of Phase Step (agility-phase-step), using Dexterity instead of Agility.

name: Piercing Attacks
text: All its attacks make the opponent bleed 2 additional HP per turn per strike tier.

name: Predatory Instinct
text: Against one opponent type (e.g. Humanoids, Automatons, Vehicles, Land Animals, Abominations, Birds, Fishes, Living Liquids): +1 per SP marque on all combat rolls and +2 to all damage classes. Repeatable once per type; an opponent fitting several types is only affected once.

name: Revitalizing
text: Acts as a natural bio-invigorator (core Bio-Flux) that uses its Spirit attribute to determine healing.

name: Sharp Senses
text: Camouflaged opponents, or opponents hidden behind cover, get no hide bonus against it from those effects.

name: Social
text: Part of a social unit (domesticated, hivemind, pride, pack…), capable of rudimentary communication; tamed as if it had half its SP (rounded up).

name: Stink
text: Sprays an enemy within 10 ft: rolls to hit, then the target resists (Brute or Spirit) against its Accuracy; on a failure the target is nauseated. Uses = SP marque (per breather); anything that changes its venom dose count changes this too.

name: Tough Body
text: +2 Wounds per SP.

name: Trample
text: +2 damage class with any melee or unarmed weapon against a prone opponent; +2 soak class against melee attacks of a prone opponent. Mostly unimpeded by prone opponents (narrator).

name: Verbally Reactive
text: Understands basic language (cannot talk back); benefits from all specialties that involve talking.

name: Versatile Essence
text: Knows three 1-slot essence augments (core essence list) and switches between them for 1 AP; only one active at a time; uses no essence slot. Augment marque = SP marque.

name: Vocal
text: Imitates normal speech convincingly without understanding it. Telling whether it speaks real words: Cunning vs the animal's Cunning.

name: Pounce
text: Called shots to the chest can knock the opponent back and prone, landing in the opponent's square. While there, the opponent counts as grabbed and cannot stand up until they break the grab or the animal disengages.

name: Slam
text: Called shots to the chest knock the opponent back an additional 5 ft and prone.

name: Winding Attack
text: Modifies a called shot to the chest: opponents who are drowning/suffocating, or start to within a turn of a successful winding attack, lose half (rounded up) of the time they could hold their breath and cannot take a last breath. The opponent counts as suffocating for the rest of their turn, so repeated Winding Attacks can suffocate them.

name: Prehensile Limbs
text: Grasping limbs: can use basic melee weapons, polearms and throwing weapons, and basic alchemical potions (medicine, poison, acid; no beta alchemy). Gains a 1 AP unarmed attack with the limbs at damage class 2, so it can grab for 1 AP.

name: Hurl
text: With an opponent grabbed: throw them 5 ft per Brute tier, dealing 5 damage per tier. A throw of more than 10 ft knocks the victim prone; throwing into a solid object/wall deals +3 damage per Brute tier.

name: Tool User
text: Understands and uses complex tools: basic ranged weapons (firearms, bows, crossbows). Can use the Sciences ability Understand to figure out any crafted item; cannot hack beta items.

name: Extra Venoms
text: +1 venom dose per SP marque.

name: Nematocysts
text: When it grabs an opponent it may spend 1 AP to apply its poison.

name: Poisonous Spit
text: Delivers its poison to an opponent up to 10 ft away; the opponent may evade the spit.

name: Acidic
text: Dissolves most untreated organic material. An acid spit/nematocyst grab may target an opponent or an item at the normal cost. Against a dissolvable item = normal sundering attempt with Accuracy +1 tier. Against a person in dissolvable armor: Dexterity vs the animal's Accuracy; soak class −1 per Accuracy tier, tiered down by the Dexterity roll.

name: Blinding
text: Blinded status for a number of turns by SP marque.

name: Burn Inducing
text: Burnt status at a tier by SP marque.

name: Deafening
text: Deafened status for a number of turns by SP marque.

name: Local Swelling
text: When delivering the poison it picks a called-shot location; the target gets that location's Wound effect until their next breather or an antitoxin. Once per opponent at a time (a new use replaces the old one). If delivered by a called shot, that location is used; eyes/ears/neck → head wound effect, groin → chest wound effect.

name: Maddening
text: Rage: the victim spends AP (by SP marque) attacking wildly, first whoever recently attacked them, then anyone nearby.

name: Mentally Clouding
text: Penalty to Cunning and Sciences rolls for a number of turns by SP marque.

name: Muscle Relaxing
text: The victim falls prone involuntarily and cannot get up for a time by SP marque.

name: Nauseating
text: Nausea status, but it lasts until the victim has spent AP by SP marque.

name: Necrosis
text: Any wound effect the victim gets while poisoned is permanent until a doctor treats it or it is otherwise healed.

name: Neurotoxin
text: Stunned for an amount of AP by SP marque.

name: Painful
text: Unsoakable damage by SP marque.

name: Psychoactive
marques: Tier 2 Cunning results required to move for 1 turn
Tier 2 Cunning results required to make any actions for 2 turns
Tier 3 Cunning results required to make any actions for 3 turns
Tier 3 Cunning results required to make any actions for 4 turns
text: Hallucinations: the target must make a Cunning roll for every action; on a failure it spends 1 AP moving aimlessly (narrator). Difficulty and duration by SP marque.

name: Rusting
text: Rapid rusting agent (common near Mt. Sibrius, Siyesh): on contact, metal armor (including natural metal armor and metal suits) loses 2 soak class and all movement encumbrances worsen by −10 ft.

name: Weakening
text: Penalty to Brute and Dexterity rolls for a number of turns by SP marque.

name: Withering
text: Penalty to Spirit rolls for a number of turns by SP marque.
